overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notices were sufficiently specific despite omitting paving and a second parcel, and the landscape plan was not a topic the chair anticipated discussing 48 hours ahead.

allegations.summary: Notices for the Feb 10 and Feb 24 meetings allegedly failed to disclose that paving was part of the project under consideration.
allegations.key_passage: because the Committee was not required to discuss all issues associated with the project, and, indeed, because the Chair did not anticipate doing so, we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Notices allegedly failed to list work on a second parcel (a different Map/Lot address) that was part of the same project.
allegations.key_passage: because of the address listed on the application we find that the notices accurately reflected what the Committee anticipated discussing during the two meetings.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly considered a landscape plan at the Feb 24 meeting that was not listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Chair did not anticipate discussion of the matter 48 hours prior to the meeting and we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law in this respect.
